fusions.name: Bigger Game
fusions.desc: A mauling bite that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Cornered Fury
fusions.desc: Rears and swipes in a full circle, which deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Shared Den
fusions.desc: Digs a den where you stand for 10 seconds; it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles of it. The effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Winter Fat
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
